cause: Training/serving skew on f2. Joining training_sample and serving_log on entity_id in BigQuery, features f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (mean abs diff = 0, correlation = 1.0), while f2 diverges (mean abs diff = 7.88, correlation = 0.878). The relationship is exact: train_f2 = ln(1 + serve_f2) (i.e. serve_f2 = exp(train_f2) - 1), verified with max error ~1e-6. So the training pipeline applied a log1p (natural-log) transform to f2, but the online serving path served the raw, untransformed value. Serving is missing the log1p transform that training applied.
